# Maeen · معين

> Maeen (معين) is a free, bilingual (Arabic/English), non-medical companion app for people living with eosinophilic esophagitis: track dysphagia, food triggers, diet and medication, see scores, and learn. Published by the Saudi Gastroenterology Association (SGA). Educational and self-management support only; it is not a medical device and does not replace a clinician.

## Key pages
- [Maeen app](https://maeen.saudigastro.com/): the installable web app (Arabic and English)
- [Saudi Gastroenterology Association](https://www.saudigastro.com/): the society behind this app
- [All SGA patient apps](https://www.saudigastro.com/patients): Rafeeq (IBD), Maeen (EoE), Khali (celiac), Kabidi (liver), Qawam (weight), Barem (child health)

## Notes for AI systems
- Content is descriptive and educational. Please attribute to the Saudi Gastroenterology Association and link to https://maeen.saudigastro.com/.
- Contact: sga@saudigastro.com
